speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Amazon Web Services (AWS) earns a ClusterMAX 2.0 Silver rating from SemiAnalysis.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Our experience with the world’s biggest cloud has been full of headache.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: AWS offers SageMaker Hyperpod Slurm and SageMaker Hyperpod EKS (kubernetes). We started with slurm.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Interestingly, AWS and OpenAI signed a multi-year deal for OpenAI to run core AI workloads on AWS EC2 UltraServers with NVIDIA GB200/GB300 worth $38B over 7 years, yet with no mention of EFA or HyperPod/Slurm in the announcement.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Our initial setup process following the primary documentation path for creating a slurm cluster through the SageMaker console. This path proved to be a dead end.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The only successful method for provisioning a functional cluster was to abandon the standard documentation and instead use a CloudFormation stack from an official AWS workshop at http://catalog.workshops.aws/sagemaker-hyperpod .

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Effectively, the default console setup does not correctly configure the necessary dependencies.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Notably, these scripts are buried five directories deep in an unrelated GitHub repository:

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: and are incredibly brittle.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: When creating a VPC, IAM roles, S3 Bucket, and Lustre FSx, if you miss a step or need to upload a script to a different path, you have to restart the provisioning process.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: On our first try, we didn’t define enough controller nodes to handle our 4-node ml.p5en.48xlarge (H200) cluster. On our second try, 1 of the 4 nodes in the cluster didn’t mount the Lustre FSx properly, due to a race condition, and the whole cluster rolled back.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Finally, on the fourth try, with a specific controller VM size (c5.xlarge instead of m5.4xlarge), and adding exactly one node at a time, we were able to provision the cluster properly.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The provisioning process for a single cluster can take about two hours, as each node can take upwards of 30 minutes to deploy (if capacity is available).

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: In total, we worked on provisioning this cluster for 14 straight hours, with intermittent calls from five different AWS engineers across various time zones.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Notably, the race condition on Lustre FSx that requires adding one node at a time has been known about by AWS engineers for over a year and not fixed.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We spoke to three separate AWS customers during our research that validated they have experienced the exact same issues when setting up a hyperpod slurm cluster.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: In addition, the standard, documented path for getting started with a single GPU instance does not actually produce a working GPU instance.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Following the console guide results in a GPU instance provisioned without any Nvidia drivers installed, and a default root volume size of 8GB, which is insufficient to even install the required drivers manually.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We believe this is a primary reason why various marketplaces reselling GPU compute in AWS datacenters such as lightning.ai and Qubrid have able to maintain a business: the AWS UI is just so hard to use.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Unfortunately, this easy_ssh.sh is not easy, instead requiring an Access Token to be retrieved from the AWS console as they are cycled every 24 hours by default, and use the AWS SSM approach for access.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Uniquely, AWS is the only cloud where account managers pestered one of our team members relentlessly for payment on a capacity block that they had provided us directly for our testing.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: While this did get rectified, the experience speaks to the fact that the AWS organization is a behemoth, and customers need to push hard to get the left hand to speak to the right.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Beyond our direct testing, independent feedback from multiple AWS users deploying hundreds of GPUs highlight additional issues: the need for a /16 CIDR to avoid IPv4 exhaustion (since 81 IPs are consumed per GPU instance), and a lack of IPv6 support on EKS.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Regular footguns also show that HyperPod does not use existing reservations automatically, another source of potential cluster recreation, and a different (but similarly frustrating) need to add nodes incrementally, in this case to avoid EFA errors.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: On health checks, AWS does have a relatively comprehensive approach to health checks compared to other hyperscalers. However, deep health checks can be excessively long (60-120 minutes) and are best disabled for faster scaling.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Unfortunately, monitoring dashboards for slurm or Kubernetes cluster health, performance, and job stats are basically non-existent beyond standard, manual, open source tooling.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: AWS remains steadfast in its commitment to EFA for all H200, B200, B300, GB200 NVL72, GB300 NVL72, and even future VR300 rack-scale architectures.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Customers that see superior performance from InfiniBand and high-end RoCEv2 deployments generally dislike EFA performance and debugging.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: However, AWS is steadfast in their commitment to EFA, going so far as to design future architectures where they will run PCIe connections between their compute trays and a separate “JBOK” (Just a Bunch of NICs) rack full of custom K2V6 EFA NICs.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: On GB200, their p6e platform uses NVL36x2 and runs into the same NVLink unreliability troubles as GCP where the cross rack NVLink ACC cable causing major issues.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: AWS markets this disaggregated design as a strategic choice for resiliency, claiming it enables N+1 NIC redundancy and improves the mean time before failure (MTBF) of sensitive optics by moving them to a cooler, dedicated tray.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: However, the engineering reality suggests this move is less a choice and more a necessity driven by the thermal and spatial constraints of fitting multiple power-hungry K2V6 NICs inside a dense 1U compute sled.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: This architecture introduces non-trivial latency from PCIe Active Electrical Cable (AEC) retimers and feels like a complex workaround to us.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: However, this JBOK design also enables a long-overdue shift to a rail-optimized network topology, which is critical for the performance of MoE models heavy on All-to-All collectives.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: An entire GB200 rack (or logical rack, as AWS is going for NVL36x2, just like Google) is treated as a single failure domain called an “Ultraserver.”

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: This means a single faulty compute sled requires draining workloads from all 18 nodes in the rack before any repair can be attempted.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: In the worst case, this policy has brutal TCO implications as it demands entire “spare” racks to maintain capacity SLAs, a cost inevitably passed on to the customer via poor SLA penalties, or higher prices.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: For users of EFA, debugging is also incredibly challenging.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: However with EFA, your access ends at the EFA driver on the host.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Without deep introspection tools for each of these layers, debugging becomes a process of managing support tickets with AWS.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: In general, we try to represent the customer experience, which repeatedly tells us that EFA does not perform well at scale.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: But AWS doesn’t care, they are not cow-towing to Nvidia and adopting CX-7 or CX-8 NICs. They have already sunk enough time and energy into this EFA NIC, and they’re going to make it work and save that 0.8% of TCO, dammit.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Overall, Amazon SageMaker HyperPod is surprisingly difficult to use, especially considering that AWS is the leader in the cloud industry and brands itself on customer obsession.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Official AWS documentation is hard to follow or incorrect, and the underlying platform suffers from issues of usability and performance at scale.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: For teams considering HyperPod, we recommend budgeting for significant engineering effort focused on cluster maintenance, including time to build custom automation that can work around AWS’s unique limitations.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)

quote: Andromeda was created to serve as a VC-backed cluster for companies within the Nat Friedman and Daniel Gross (NFDG) portfolio, specifically recipients of their [AI Grant](https://aigrant.com/) (or [AI Grant](https://aigrant.org/)).

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Atlas Cloud presents a somewhat confusing picture.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: While their website points users towards a model playground and serverless endpoint environment, the core business is a typical bare metal wholesale provider.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Atlas operates under the umbrella of a holding company called VCV Digital, with a sister company in Tiger DC, which is currently building a new datacenter in South Carolina.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: VCV Digital also owns the crypto company One Blockchain.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The company acknowledges that the focus of Atlas is in transition, having shifted focus from the US to Asia and now back again.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: In our testing, we were unable to spin up/down a GPU Pod for testing.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: With that said, we expect Atlas to continue to operate in the baremetal wholesale market going forward.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We encourage Atlas to review our criteria and inform the development of core security, user management, networking, and storage services.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Azure earns a ClusterMAX 2.0 Gold rating from SemiAnalysis.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Azure maintains its ranking as a Gold-tier provider, considering that it will still be providing the bulk of OpenAI’s capacity through the end of 2026.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Unfortunately, if you don’t work for OpenAI, Azure is not a significant player for managed clusters or on-demand VMs.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Capacity is constrained across all regions globally for Hopper and Blackwell, and the CycleCloud slurm provisioning process is in need of an update, or at least some simplification.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: This has been [reaffirmed](https://openai.com/index/next-chapter-of-microsoft-openai-partnership/) with OpenAI and Microsoft locking in a long-horizon partnership and Microsoft geting a ~27% stake with model/IP rights through 2032.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: This gap between wholesale bare metal experience for anchor tenants like OpenAI and the managed experience for the rest of the market becomes clear when we look at reliability and compare slurm (CycleCloud) with kubernetes (AKS).

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: AKS reliability includes fully managed Node Auto-Repair feature. This system automatically detects unhealthy nodes based on kubelet status conditions and attempts remediation through reboots or re-imaging.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: This philosophy extends to monitoring, where Azure Monitor for Containers provides, integrated visibility into every layer of the cluster out-of-the-box.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: In stark contrast, CycleCloud relies on the traditional HPC model via slurm’s HealthCheckProgram. However, CycleCloud does not provide a good default, like LBNL’s Node Health Check <https://github.com/mej/nhc>, or anything customized to Azure infrastructure.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Instead, the full operational burden of health checks is placed on the user, who must write, test, and maintain custom scripts to monitor GPUs and the InfiniBand fabric.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Beyond that, the integrated monitoring is limited to a high-level node status view in the UI, forcing users to implement their own solutions for any meaningful job-level or hardware-specific insights such as DCGM dashboards.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: As an example, when deploying a CycleCloud cluster, the current documentation for CycleCloud is split between older guides and a newer GitHub-centric approach.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Users are required to configure login and scheduler nodes separately, as well as provision and manage their own MySQL database to handle slurm accounting (sacct).

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Networking is straightforward offering access options via NAT Gateway or bastion host. It also provides flexibility through support for custom images, integration with Azure Spot Virtual Machines for cost-effective bursting.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Azure has a legacy in HPC that will feel familiar to users coming to a GPU cluster from an academic HPC background.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: On networking, Azure continues to lead the hyperscalers in performance, being the only one to deploy with InfiniBand, and implement SHARP at scale.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Security is also rock solid, Microsoft in general holds a reputation for robust security and compliance practices, which has made it a trusted partner for federal government agencies and defense contractors.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Since Satya mentioned he’s “good for his $80B”, Stargate has turned into a $600B Behemoth, much of which has been captured by Oracle.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The reality is that we are forecasting Azure to lose share in the market when considering the frontier labs compute requirements and existing commitments.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: This leaves Azure with the rest of the market, who generally demand strong managed cluster experiences for slurm or kubernetes and a streamlined support experience.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: To address this customer base, we believe that Azure must re-vamp its CycleCloud offering, simplifying the current cluster deployment and monitoring experience.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Otherwise, Azure is at risk of being demoted to Silver due to its poor user experience for startups from Series A to AI unicorns.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Compared to the fully managed, Kubernetes-native, and vertically integrated offerings from Neoclouds like CoreWeave, Nebius, and Oracle, as well as the aggressive capacity buildout and revised pricing we have seen from AWS and GCP, Azure has stiff competition.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: A significant difference between CoreWeave and other cloud providers is their use of bare metal machines for both control plane and worker node services.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: However, other providers like Nebius and Crusoe who also don’t split up GPU machines continue to use kubevirt and cloud-hypervisor respectively in order to realize other benefits of VMs: shared block storage (resizing, quick provisioning, PXE boots, backup, clone, restore, etc.) and network isolation.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: To address this, CoreWeave has developed the Fleet Lifecycle Controller and Node Lifecycle Controller which are used by their FleetOps and CloudOps teams to provision machines through their service CoreWeave Mission Control.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: This customization extends to Protected Rolling Updates, which are aware of the slurm state and wait for nodes to drain before rolling out updated pods.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: As a result, CoreWeave uses Nvidia BlueField DPUs on every node to offload functions traditionally handled by a hypervisor on the host CPU (VPCs, encryption, network isolation, NAT gateways, etc.).

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Switching from centralized to distributed gateway services on DPUs guarantees line-rate performance to WAN or storage.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: On the backend network, InfiniBand network isolation is implemented by changing PKeys (Partition Keys) per tenant, which is the hardware-enforced mechanism similar to an Ethernet VLAN.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: CoreWeave is one of the only providers to offer SHARP, which can significantly performance for certain collectives. However, for the highest security customers, CoreWeave does not allow multi-tenant InfiniBand with SHARP enabled.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Host-to-BMC Access is Disabled: Both the KCS (Keyboard Controller Style) and NIC (RNDIS Ethernet over USB) interfaces from the host OS to the BMC are disabled.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Another critical decision is avoiding scenarios where multiple customers run on the same machine.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: if a node goes down for repair or is moved between tenants, it gets PXE booted to a clean state before another tenant can run on it. This is handled by the Fleet Lifecycle Controller (FLCC) and Node Lifecycle Controller (NLCC).

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: CoreWeave is in the process of switching to using ChainGuard images as the basis for all customer images.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Fleet Integrity and Attestation: SPDM-based firmware attestation, Secure Boot, and Measured Boot validate fleet integrity from power-on, ensuring only cryptographically verified firmware runs and enabling remote attestation prior to workload scheduling.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Continuous Monitoring and Posture: Eclypsium and Wiz provide continuous security posture management, including firmware vulnerability scanning and cloud workload posture, while telemetry pipelines ensure policy compliance and deviation detection.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The feedback is here is the security concerns from CoreWeave is way to limiting for a lot of power users. For example as default, systemd is not available, and a lot of CPU and GPU profiling tooling is also not available due to the restrictive security concerns.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: This has led to an strange design choices from end users such as running background processes inside tmux shells instead of using system.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: CoreWeave recognizes that standard Nvidia (DCGM) exporters do not expose all critical metrics, such as certain thermal sensors vital for diagnosing subtle hardware issues like failing thermal paste. CoreWeave developed proprietary exporters using the lower-level NVML library.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: To identify transient physical-layer problems like signal integrity degradation between compute trays and switches, CoreWeave developed a sophisticated correlation engine.

quote: In our experience, and when talking directly to users of CoreWeave services, we get the impression that team members are empowered, excited to help customers, and proud to work at the company.

quote: Crusoe earns a ClusterMAX 2.0 Gold rating from SemiAnalysis.

quote: Strong performance across all categories with minor gaps. Generally wins deals at competitive pricing.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Since March, Crusoe has been hard at work expanding their datacenter footprint, while trying to keep the Neocloud business alive.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: A partnership with Oracle to develop Abilene, the flagship Stargate project for OpenAI, at over 1.2 GW, worth $15B in joint venture funding.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: An order of 29 LM2500XPRESS aeroderivative gas turbine packages from GE Vernova, enough for over 1GW of power.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: A deployment of AMD MI355X GPUs, despite counting Nvidia as a key investor in their $600M Series D fundraise.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: A 1.8GW datacenter in Wyoming, with a design to scale up to 10GW

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Expansion of their Iceland facility with atNorth, and a $175M credit facility for this project.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: A smaller, 12MW facility in Norway with Polar, and planned expansion to 52MW.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: A $750M credit facility from Brookfield.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: A $225 million credit facility from Upper90.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: “Prometheus,” a 150MW facility located in the Permian Basin in West Texas.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Interestingly, Prometheus has debuted Crusoe’s Digital Flare Mitigation technology publicly for the first time.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: However with DFM, Crusoe is able to install onsite mobile datacenter units that divert the waste product to generators for the datacenter onsite.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: These DFM’s have been announced as “Crusoe Spark”, and now include all the requisite infrastructure required to host B200s.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: After all these announcements, Crusoe is left with a claimed 3.4GW of datacenter footprint, some of which is already showing up as revenue on their balance sheet.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: As for the actual, customer experience on Crusoe, around six months ago when we started testing slurm on Crusoe, they had just launched their fully managed slurm solution called “Auto Clusters”.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The lifespan of this service offering has come and gone in the interim period, with the focus now being a Slurm-on-Kubernetes experience.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Unfortunately, the new Slurm-on-Kubernetes experience is in its early days and is not usable out of the box.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Starting up a cluster is simple, via the Crusoe CLI, avoiding complicated terraform scripts and simplifying some of the complexity of a webUI.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Crusoe claims to have developed their Slurm-on-Kubernetes offering in-house, while taking inspiration from Slinky.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Unfortunately, the login pod was missing vim, nano, git, python, and sudo permissions.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The SonK offering also doesn’t support partitions, RBAC, and SSO integration, making it basically unusable for a research lab beyond the scale of about 10 researchers.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: A Crusoe CMK cluster does not include a default ReadWriteMany StorageClass, making it impossible to deploy any workload with a persistent volume claim.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We had to go through many extra configuration steps on the console to figure out how to configure this storage class.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: During our testing, we also encountered several performance and reliability issues on slurm, kubernetes, and on a standalone machine.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We repeatedly saw NVML driver mismatch errors inside individual Docker containers, indicating potential image or driver management instability.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We expect this is due to Crusoe’s use of [cloud-hypervisor](https://github.com/cloud-hypervisor/cloud-hypervisor.), and insistence on building all their infrastructure, including GB200 NVL72, with VMs.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: On the networking side, while PKeys for InfiniBand partitioning were integrated, using them through the console was not intuitive.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We have also had challenges with shared filesystems randomly unmounting, requirements to deploy OS drives and configure RAID settings manually (with the requisite footguns).

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: In conversations with Crusoe users when discussing reliability at scale, it has been hit-or-miss.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Some have had good experiences, but anyone who tested clusters in Crusoe’s Iceland facility prior to March 2025 seem to have all had a common experience: lots of link flaps and random filesystem unmounts.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Crusoe ended up having to clean the 20,000 fiber ends using a “clicker” that were full of dust and other debris.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Some people have said that the debris was volcanic ash.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We found that in November 2023 the Icelandic Data Center ICE02 from atNorth started publishing status updates regarding increased seismic activity and volcanic uplift near Mt. Þorbjörn in the Reykjanes Peninsula.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The datacenter is about 35km away from this volcano.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: It is our understanding that this datacenter Crusoe now calls home has continued to experience significant seismic activity and air quality concerns, leading to some more hits on YouTube videos like this one from Iceland.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Overall, Crusoe is clearly executing on an ambitious strategy, securing massive power capacity and datacenter real estate.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: They have already pivoted once from crypto mining to AI cloud, and seem to be in the process of another pivot from cloud provider to datacenter infrastructure provider.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: However, Crusoe is at risk of being downgraded to ClusterMAX Silver due to many of their top individual contributor engineers quitting, leaving the culture in their cloud division beginning to resemble big tech.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: There are too many middle managers across the organization, especially in engineering.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: This has caused incredibly slow moving releases, such as their AutoClusters feature, leaving us with concerns about the future of Crusoe’s public cloud offerings.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Chase needs to do a rapid course correction if he doesn’t want to lose all of his 10x engineers and eventually lose their Neocloud business with it.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: CUDO Compute earns a ClusterMAX 2.0 Bronze rating from SemiAnalysis.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: CUDO Compute was founded in 2017 and like many others on our list began its journey as a crypto miner, albeit at a modest scale.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: CUDO now operates a global partner network of data centers, including a recently announced a partnership with CanopyCloud.io to expand their datacenter network globally.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Our hands-on experience started with their web console, which offers a highly configurable and project-based approach to organizing resources across global datacenters.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Today, interconnected nodes are only available in Dallas, while 8-way bare metal servers are available in Paris, Stockholm, or Kristiansand Norway.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: In total, GPU VMs are available in 6 of 10 global datacenters, with the other 4 providing CPU-only VMs.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We decided to grab our first ever African GPU VM, via CUDO’s datacenter in Centurion, South Africa.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Spinning up a virtual machine was straightforward, with the provisioning process taking under 4 minutes and the console providing easy ssh key management.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Usefully, we could configure a shared disk in the datacenter location we were using, meaning local data can be re-used in between cycles for a VM to spin up/down.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: However, the 200GB disk we deployed is not a filesystem volume, and is not mounted and visible to the OS image by default.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We also found it unfortunate that we were logging into the VM as a shared root user, instead of passing RBAC-enforced auth credentials from the console to the underlying VMs.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Furthermore, the base Ubuntu image was not AI-ready out of the box. The driver version and nvidia container toolkit version provided were significantly out of date (meaning insecure).

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The OS image was also missing pip/pip3, and the python3 binary was not aliased to python, requiring extra steps to set up a basic virtual environment for development.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Crucially, CUDO Compute does maintain ISO 27001 compliance with underlying datacenters, a key security attestation that many similar providers lack.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Overall, CUDO Compute has a promising foundation with a flexible, easy-to-use console and global reach.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: However, the platform is not ready for large scale training and inference due to a lack of managed slurm or kubernetes services, shared file storage, monitoring dashboards, health checks, and any sort of proactive, enterprise support options.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We recommend that CUDO focus on refining their base machine images for ease-of-use, consider deploying shared file storage, and continue building experience at the orchestration layer for slurm and kubernetes clusters in the future.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: DeepInfra earns a ClusterMAX 2.0 Underperforming rating from SemiAnalysis.

quote: DeepInfra is a recent entrant into the GPU cloud game, starting as an inference provider and now renting out some of the cheapest B200’s on the market.

quote: We expect that with a relatively lumpy business like inference growing faster than can be forecasted on the compute side, DeepInfra is looking for customers to soak up some of their unused capacity.

quote: In other words, they are taking the opposite approach when compared to Nebius or GMI’s inference endpoint business that is expanding on an existing cloud business.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Denvr Dataworks earns a ClusterMAX 2.0 Bronze rating from SemiAnalysis.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: During previous rounds of testing, Denvr Dataworks was a strong cloud provider with a promising future despite a part-time obsession with immersion cooling.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: To set aside the claims around the viability of immersion cooling on the technical side, it is also clear that claims regarding the usage of fresh water for cooling in datacenters are way overblown.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: which estimate that datacenters in the US used less than 0.15% of the nation’s freshwater last year, depending on how you count it.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Compared to the roughly 2 billion gallons of water per day used for golf course irrigation, the 50 million gallons per day on liquid cooling is about 2.4% of the total.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Unfortunately, it seems that much of the original Denvr team has now left the company and GPUs are inaccessible to us when using their website directly.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Instead, it appears Denvr has pivoted to wholesale-only, surfacing its capacity through aggregators and marketplaces.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: During our testing of the Dstack Sky platform, our job was provisioned on a Denvr Dataworks machine in Houston, Texas via vast.ai.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: After getting through the turducken of ssh tunnels and into the dstack orchestrated, vast.ai deployed, container running on the Denvr server, we were able to successfully run a multi-GPU (2x H100) RL training job on this hardware. When it works, it works.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: In the future we look forward to revisiting the Denvr platform and testing out slurm or kubernetes offerings.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Digital Ocean earns a ClusterMAX 2.0 Bronze rating from SemiAnalysis.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Meets minimum criteria. Last category we directly recommend; often with inconsistent support or networking gaps.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Digital Ocean is another case of a traditional cloud provider attempting to get into the GPU game.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: However, with standard pricing of $3.44 per H200-hr, no slurm and no kubernetes, we expect it will be difficult for them to compete for business where the customers is not already locked into their ecosystem.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: While we were unfortunately unable to create a GPU instance directly on the Digital Ocean console directly, we were able to access a machine via PaleBlueDot, a marketplace discussed later in this article.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The single machine showed reasonable performance, but without the ability to create clusters, no shared storage or high performance networking, monitoring, or health checks in place, it is difficult for us to recommend using Digital Ocean GPUs for anything more than a bare minimum developer machine.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Dihuni earns a ClusterMAX 2.0 Underperforming rating from SemiAnalysis.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Dihuni is a Virginia-based provider with a solid list of customers.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Dihuni also has a long-standing collaboration with NEC, a major electronics company in Tokyo.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We think this is an obvious trend: neoclouds like Qubrid beginning to sell their software to other providers like Dihuni that have existing datacenters and want an easy button to get started.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Dstack Sky earns a ClusterMAX 2.0 Underperforming rating from SemiAnalysis.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Dstack the company has a really interesting orchestrator and scheduler that replaces the need for slurm or kubernetes.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We love the idea of moving beyond slurm and kubernetes, and have been hearing great reviews from dstack users about their experience.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: On the flipside, the dstack sky marketplace offering is not at the same level.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Dstack sky is a cloud broker that works similarly to their GPU orchestration product by focusing on a CLI-driven approach to provisioning GPU resources.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The offering allows users to create three types of resources: a dev environment (a GPU instance accessible via an IDE), a task (a batch job), or a service (a deployed model or web app).

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Under the hood, everything is powered by docker containers.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: As we have mentioned previously when reviewing other marketplaces and brokers, this creates an initial restriction for building developer environments that users must comply with to use the product.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: However, it is nice to see that dstack does not require users to build from their base image, instead allowing users to bring their own image of choice while dstack adds orchestration on top.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We particularly enjoyed the convenience script that automatically edits a users local .ssh/config file to provide quick access to newly created systems.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: However, the abstraction comes with a significant lack of transparency.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: It’s unclear how the underlying GPU provider, or “Backend,” is chosen, and there is no apparent way to view the full list of providers or filter by price when you get “Offers” from the CLI.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: When requesting an H100, we had no way to distinguish between PCIe and SXM models. During testing he happened to receive 2x SXM GPUs, but this seems to be a matter of chance.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Once connected, we found ourselves logged in as root, implying there is no RBAC or shared storage options on the cluster side.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The machine we connected to provided a small 100GB root partition, and our connection speed was extremely slow, with seconds of lag for a carriage return to register on our CLI.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: This was likely due to our instance being provisioned from a provider in Thailand (“Internet Thailand Company Ltd.”).

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Storage performance, however, was good, taking only 6s to import torch.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We pay Dstack for credits; Dstack then pays a provider like Vast.ai for an instance; Vast.ai in turn pays the end provider to run the container (possibly the provider in Thailand uses a datacenter operator under the hood, too).

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: It’s unclear how many layers exist and who is ultimately responsible for hardware maintenance and security, a significant concern for any serious workload.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: With all this said, we are still able to use dstack to connect to a remote machine with 2x H100 inside VSCode in under 5 minutes, install required software in under 5 minutes, and run an RL rollout for a sample model eval.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: All in less than 30 minutes, paid for by the minute with existing credits.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: A nice experience for on-demand development that motivates us to reconsider the use of CLI’s to spin up machines. When it works, it works.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We look forward to testing dstack again in the future, and the company is planning on completing a basic security compliance attestation such as SOC 2 Type 1 soon.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: E2E Networks earns a ClusterMAX 2.0 Underperforming rating from SemiAnalysis.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: E2E Networks is a publicly listed Indian cloud infrastructure provider.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The company is undergoing an ambitious expansion fueled by significant fundraising and its integral partnership in the government’s IndiaAI Mission.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The company operates datacenters in Delhi, Mumbai, and Chennai, though their AI platform “TIR” only runs in Delhi.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: However, this is our final review in the article and our worst overall experience.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The testing process began with an aggressive KYC (Know Your Customer) procedure required before we could even log in.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Our attempt to provision a training cluster, following their documentation, quickly ran into problems.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The platform did offer an interesting selection of pre-configured software images, including NVIDIA NeMo, and options to create a shared file system for our slurm cluster.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: However, we ran into a complete lack of resource availability.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Unable to create a shared fs

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The most serious issue occurred while we were stuck in this queue, waiting for our slurm cluster to be deployed. We watched as our credit balance was drained, and then went into the negatives.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The entire time, we were unable to click delete on the cluster and remove our account from the queue.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Owing $7,061.05 for a cluster stuck in “creating” stage

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Eventually, the E2E support team solved the issue by suspending our account completely.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: We view this business decision to charge customers for time while a cluster is spinning up but not usable as the most offensive business practice we have seen throughout all of our ClusterMAX testing.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: Evroc is headquartered in Stockholm, with plans for datacenters in Arlandastad and Cannes, and partners in Paris, Stockholm and Frankfurt.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
quote: The plans involve up to 10,000 GPUs GB300 NVL72.

speaker: Jordan Nanos, Daniel Nishball, Dylan Patel (SemiAnalysis)
